lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region. Spot density is highest immediately posterior to the gills, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced centroids moving caudally along the horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, creating intersection points with the high-luminance blobs that form a rectilinear lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the superior third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.
